newsitem.title: MEXICO: Vitro sees Anchor sale completed in Dec.
newsitem.headline: Vitro sees Anchor sale completed in Dec.

text.p: Mexican glassmaker Vitro SA could complete its sale of troubled Anchor Glass Container Corp in December, a top official said on Thursday.

"I believe the finishing touches should be put on the sale in the month of December. It now doesn't depend on Vitro, it depends on the court because we are in the process of Chapter 11 bankruptcy," Pablo Gonzalez Sada, head of Vitro's flat glass unit, told Reuters.

Anchor filed for Chapter 11 protection in U.S. Bankruptcy Court in Delaware on Sept 13 as Vitro sought to sell it to Ball-Foster Glass Container Co LLC. That transaction was sealed on Oct. 4, with Ball Foster paying $365 million in cash and the assumption of certain liabilities.
The deal has to be approved by the bankruptcy court.
Gonzalez Sada said Vitro employees working at Anchor Glass have now returned to Mexico.
